mapper.select: SELECT w.workspace_id FROM workspaces w JOIN workspace_domains d ON w.workspace_id = d.workspace_id WHERE d.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND d.active = 'Y'
mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_members WHERE project_id = p.project_id AND status = 0 ) AS member_count
mapper.select:
SELECT p.project_id, p.workspace_id, p.subject, p.content, TO_CHAR(p.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(p."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, p.status, p.progress, p.archive, TO_CHAR(p.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created, ,
FROM projects p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspace_id} AND p.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY p.project_id DESC
SELECT MAX(workspace_member_id) FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND member_id = #{actorId} AND status = 0 AND role = 70
mapper.sql: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members actor WHERE actor.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND actor.member_id = #{memberId} AND actor.status = 0 AND (actor.role = 70 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members own WHERE own.project_id = p.project_id AND own.workspace_member_id = actor.workspace_member_id AND own.status = 0 )) )
mapper.select:
SELECT p.project_id AS "projectId", p.subject AS "projectName", DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.content, 1000, 1) AS "content", TO_CHAR(p.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startAt", TO_CHAR(p."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endAt", p.status AS "status", p.progress AS "progress" FROM projects p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND NVL(p.archive, 'N') = 'N'
ORDER BY p.start_at, p.project_id

SELECT t.task_id AS "taskId", t.project_id AS "projectId", t.title AS "title", p.subject AS "projectName", DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t.content, 1000, 1) AS "content", TO_CHAR(t.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startAt", TO_CHAR(t."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endAt", t.status AS "status", t.progress AS "progress", NVL(md.name, '미지정') AS "assignee" FROM tasks t JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = t.project_id LEFT JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_member_id = t.project_member_id AND pm.project_id = p.project_id LEFT JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id LEFT JOIN member_details md ON md.member_id = wm.member_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND NVL(p.archive, 'N') = 'N' AND t.deleted IS NULL
ORDER BY t.start_at, t.task_id
